summary: School Info Page feature testing completed. All backend API tests pass (8/8). All frontend UI tests pass. Page renders correctly with Duke University showing school name, D1 division, ACC conference, South region, coaching staff (3 coaches), and school details.

backend_api.GET /api/knowledge-base/school/duke.edu: PASS - Returns school data with university_name, division (D1), conference (ACC), region (South), domain, on_board, match_score, match_reasons
backend_api.School has coach data: PASS - Duke has coaches: Benard Cutrone (Head Coach), Maggie Catherina, Jaime Kosiorek
backend_api.Scorecard data available: INFO - May be empty if not synced via admin

frontend_school_info_page.Add to Board button: PASS - Functional, changes to 'On Your Board' after click with toast notification
frontend_school_info_page.Coaching Staff section: PASS - Shows 3 coaches with names, titles, and email links
frontend_school_info_page.School Details section: PASS - Location, Division, Conference, Mascot, Scholarship, Program Website, School Website
frontend_school_info_page.Back button: PASS - Navigates back to Find Schools

critical_code_review_comments: SchoolInfoPage.js correctly uses data-testid attributes for all key elements
API endpoint properly returns school data with match_score and on_board status
Coach data fallback logic handles both coaches_scraped array and legacy primary_coach/recruiting_coordinator fields
Key Statistics section only shows when scorecard data is available (conditional rendering)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing Duke University data
context_for_next_testing_agent: School Info Page at /school/:domain route fully tested. Duke University (duke.edu) is a good test case with full coach data. The page shows hero header, action buttons (Add to Board, Email Coach, Visit Website), coaching staff cards, and school details table. Match score ring only appears if user has athlete profile with match_score > 0.
